visualReview.notes: Inspected every listed frame after remapping all upper stages. The seven-tier silhouette, extended green spire, brick tent, octagonal windows, three lower gallery tiers and gate vault are intact. The official NE lean is present without separating the tiers; doors and parapet panels remain legible.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: All shared-material angles, details and orthographic placement frame were inspected. Metric brick and painted metal bindings resolve across square and octagonal stages. Gate bars, capitals, recesses and crown are coherent. The lower square footprint is visibly shorter than the mapped rectangular lower polygon, which is recorded as a geographic uncertainty rather than hidden by model scaling.

geographicReview.notes: Exact-QID OSM wall axis and repeated part centroids establish center/orientation, and the official NE lean is transformed consistently. However the official 140 m² square base conflicts with the 18×12.9 m mapped lower polygon; the orthographic frame confirms that mismatch. Determine which mapped projections belong to the exterior lower tier before final footprint approval.

fidelityReview.notes: Maximum exterior fidelity remains pending: resolve the lower footprint discrepancy and refine pylon faces, exact gallery panel profiles, the south/north small doors and figurative forged gate ornament. Current stage heights incorporate explicit mapped building parts and the official photograph. This is a detailed exterior preview, not a maximum-detail approval.
